description.value:
The gray-haired outlander brought many novel concepts to Okhema, and this drink was one of them. After countless sleepless nights and tireless effort, several of the best drinksmiths finally recreated the "coffee" that the Navigator had carefully crafted in the outlander's memories.
According to {F#her}{M#him}, it tasted even better than what {F#she}{M#he} remembered.

"Ah... so coffee doesn't have to scald your esophagus after all!"

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. Each affected creature regains 30% maximum Energy. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. Once per turn it adds its proficiency bonus to one damage roll. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, immediately regenerates 30% Energy for all allies and increases DMG dealt by 15% for the next battle.
